product: CATVERSE Twin-Ledger Enterprise Finance OS — AOXPET Base Lab

lanes.base_fact: A payer deposits a supported asset through the Base Ledger Portal.
lanes.enterprise_control: Capture payer intent, asset, amount and business reference before creating an ERP settlement draft.
lanes.erp_boundary: No Payment Entry, GL posting or customer balance update occurs from a deposit notification alone.

lanes.base_fact: Ledger balances and transfers remain private within the ledger.
lanes.enterprise_control: Keep counterparty-facing payment detail outside the public evidence surface; retain only a canonical business-event hash and review status.
lanes.erp_boundary: ERP remains the accounting authority for receivable, clearing and recognition.

lanes.base_fact: A withdrawal is the onchain finality point for an asset and amount.
lanes.enterprise_control: Require receipt, finality readback, idempotency lock and human review before a draft-only ledger handoff.
lanes.erp_boundary: Draft-only is not submitted, posted, cancelled or deleted by this console.

negative_controls: no onchain deposit, private transfer or withdrawal
no ERP credential or ERP write
no claim that a private ledger settlement has occurred
next_gate: A separate approved, real business settlement lifecycle with payer, asset, amount, receipt/finality and ERP draft-only scope is required before this mapping can become settlement evidence.
